content: Table 4 shows the confusion matrix of Joint on Wikipedia. We can see that more than 50% of documents for each quality class are correctly classified, except for the C class where more documents are misclassified into B. Analysis shows that when misclassified, documents are usually misclassified into adjacent quality classes, which can be explained by the Wikipedia grading scheme, where the criteria for adjacent quality classes are more similar.
